December 19, 2024

# Deprecated `SubscriptionMailingAddress` in favor of `MailingAddress`

DateDecember 19, 2024

Version[2025-07](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-07)

Flags[Breaking API Change](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=breaking-api-change)[Action required](https://shopify.dev/changelog?action_required=true)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of the 2025-07 version of the GraphQL Admin API, we've deprecated the [`SubscriptionMailingAddress`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/SubscriptionMailingAddress) object. Use the [`MailingAddress`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/MailingAddress) object instead.
